These extensible, globally-recognized specifications bring new functionality and enhanced security to the evolution of devices, firmware and operating systems, as well as facilitate interoperability between platforms and systems that comply with next-generation technologies. The Forum is comprised of the world\xe2\x80\x99s foremost researchers in academia, eminent computer scientists and technology industry leaders from more than 250 member companies, working to develop and maintain the full suite of the UEFI and ACPI specifications.
